scientific_integrity: Analytic factorization proves the infinite-domain comparison; the attached exact-rational checker corroborates algebra and finite-horizon recursions. Stationary mean bias and unperformed independent audit are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results for a specified pair of strictly convex scalar quadratics, constant-step unaveraged SGD, stationary irreducible symmetric two-state Markov sampling, and squared Euclidean last-iterate error. No universal sampling rule, finite-horizon comparison, or publication-priority guarantee.
title: A sharp Markov-persistence risk reversal for strictly contractive two-component SGD
